audit.notes: The new chapter blocks successfully cover all scientifically useful content from the old draft. Block 6 covers heterogeneous BEOL integration of TFLN/Si and metasurfaces (S05-P009, S05-P025, S05-P033). Blocks 2-5 cover inverse design techniques, deep learning architectures, generalization limits, and fabrication constraints (S05-P001, S05-P065, S05-P073, S05-P080, S05-P066, S05-P067, S05-P060, S05-P049, S05-P013, S05-P085, S05-P105). Block 8 covers thermal crosstalk challenges (S05-P114). Block 9 covers open questions regarding energy comparisons and system-level co-design gaps (S05-P017, S05-P125). No mechanisms, quantified results, or boundary conditions present in the old draft are missing in the new blocks.
